optimization: O1 for driver and local runtime libraries
client_rts: same frozen candidate executable, no RTS override; one default capability
fixture: fresh disposable database per leg; 100k workflow and 100k mixed timer rows, 64 KiB values; 50 warm writer operations; checkpoint before warmup
writer_schema: native 0.21.0.0 manifest, lock and snapshot byte-identical; no inspection DDL
limitations: local paired medians and full raw variation; no universal zero-overhead or confidence-bound claim
capacity_acceptance: separate five alternating final-candidate pairs in ../readside-writer-capacity
dependency_selection: explicit -package-id arguments for direct benchmark dependencies in each matching Cabal plan, through nix develop -c cabal exec -- ghc; distinct output directories
allocation_precision: GHC per-thread counters are approximate to 4 KiB; process allocation is diagnostic
offered_rate_scope: one completed operation schedules/claims/resumes/releases a workflow and schedules/claims/fires a timer
